causal_chain_maps.note: The six links of the US IT services chain. The first four are about what makes customers spend -- budgets and their lag, bookings leading revenue, the AI budget pool, the annuity share -- and the last two are about delivery economics and the cash that trails them. Mapped by position and bound to the hash of the whole chain: a chain that gains, loses or reorders a link no longer matches this entry, and those two sections go unavailable until a person maps it again. That is deliberate. Which section a new causal link belongs to is a methodology question, and a rule that guessed would quietly rewrite the Constitution's shape into whatever the keywords suggested.

output_rubric_bindings.reason: This criterion is about the weekly brief's contents. A dossier is not a weekly brief, so there is nothing here for a structural check to read. Declared rather than skipped: a criterion nobody mentions is a standard nobody applied.
Every number in an output traces to evidence: each figure in the prose must appear verbatim in a row the sentence cites.
Outputs never auto-generate investment conclusions. A dossier that says buy, sell or a target price has stopped being a file and become a call, and a call is admitted by a person (ADR-0001).
A good research output reduces the open question set or sharpens a falsifier; a bad one restates known facts. Structurally: a new version cites something the current one did not.
